zh.summary: 支持官方 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 内核。
highlights: 新增可选内核 0.2.1-alpha.4（官方最新测试版）。内核列表保留最新三个，其中始终包含最新的 RC 版 0.2.0-rc.2。
插件管理页的 Portable 按钮适配了官方 alpha.4 的新页面结构。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。
整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。

en.summary: Support for the official DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 core.
highlights: Adds the selectable core 0.2.1-alpha.4 (the latest official test build). The list keeps the newest three and always includes the newest RC, 0.2.0-rc.2.
The Portable buttons on the plugin manager page are adapted to the page structure of official alpha.4.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically.
